Applied Energistics, the endgame of all storage — and, in this pack, a day-one luxury. Most packs gate ME networks behind HV circuits; the legacy MIAO line had a different idea: drop a working network on the pioneer's bench early and let automation carry the grind.

This zone honors that idea: the very next milestones hand you a starter network, then teach channels, buses, autocrafting, P2P, wireless, quantum links and fluid AE until your little network runs itself.

Bring curiosity. The materials asked are deliberately trivial — the cats are buying.
